notes: source.epoch.tasks.v1 with CT24-CLEANUP-TASK-COMPOSITION's bounded success-arm placement: the parent lends `owner` to the child as a counted read share, then directly in the exact Result::Ok arm executes a handled region whose pack adopts that same owner and whose discharge erases to `drop owner;` at the region statement before the later join. The unedited scoped-task ledger refuses the release at Q600 LoanOutstanding. The case therefore reaches parse, elaboration, task lowering and task-ledger checking on its own artifact, but returns from the task half before epoch lowering or bound checking; the accepted controls exercise those later stages only on their own artifacts and confer no stage credit on the case. Same-owner cleanup after join and independent-owner cleanup before join both admit and publish released=[owner], abandoned=3, so the rejection is neither a blanket placement refusal nor an unsupported-region fallback. Missing join still refuses at the same live-loan release; nested if, nested loop and Result::Err placements refuse at Q302; unsupported region-body syntax refuses at Q302; and consuming the opened cleanup pack twice refuses at Q304. No native or proof stage is claimed: the rejected artifact emits nothing, and the audited Lean module is an abstract rule theorem with no artifact-bound runner.

controls.note: The same counted read loan and same adopting cleanup, with only the join moved before the region. The task ledger closes the loan, then admits the erased release; the region publishes exactly the owner and remainder the case intended to clean.
The cleanup remains before a later join but destroys an independent owner while the child carries only a scalar copy. Acceptance proves the new placement itself is not the refusal.
Removing the later join cannot make the cleanup acceptable: the first refusal remains the cleanup release against the live counted share.
A region nested one level further under an arbitrary if stays outside the bounded placement.
A region nested one level further under a loop stays outside the bounded placement.
Only the exact Result::Ok arm receives cleanup composition; the spawn-error arm keeps its written recovery and cannot acquire this conditional evidence.
The existing linear cleanup capability refuses a second discharge; the new placement does not weaken pack consumption.
A return inside the region body is outside the decided straight-line cleanup grammar and refuses before erasure.
